name: FFTA Expansion
notes: Mystic Knight enchantments work with every weapon: the eleven enchantments, Spellbreak, Arcane Burst and Break Ench. accept any primary weapon (for example a Sniper with secondary Spellblade can enchant a greatbow), and enchant strikes and Spellbreak use the weapon's own Fight range. Spell Parry and Blade Combo still need a rapier or saber. Spellbreak now removes one random buff on a hit, which also fixes the stray graphics that appeared when scrolling the Spellblade list. The enchantments are renamed 'X Ench.' (Fire Ench., Holy Ench., Break Ench.). Help text longer than two lines continues on a second page (press A), as in the original game; 114 descriptions were cut off before. Weapon descriptions now use the skill names shown in menus. Saves from 0.7 and 0.7.1 remain compatible; load an in-game save after updating.
